summary: Minimal documentation-only design: add a concise RC smoke-test note to the existing README.md without changing code, configuration, or dependencies.
title: Add RC smoke-test note to README
reviewReasons: Single-file documentation-only change with no runtime, security, dependency, or architectural impact.

definitionOfDone.description: README.md contains a concise note identifying the repository or change as an RC smoke test.
Only README.md is modified; no source, configuration, generated, or dependency files change.
The resulting Markdown is readable and preserves the existing repository title.

architectureDecisions: Keep the change documentation-only and place the RC smoke-test note directly in README.md near the existing title.

risks.description: An ambiguous note could make the smoke-test purpose unclear.
risks.mitigation: Use one explicit sentence containing the terms RC and smoke test.
